message:
{
  "verdict": "pass",
  "summary": "The shipped player mesh matches the approved concept part for part. It is within budget at 4,893 of 5,500 triangles, keeps the concept colors after correction, has a clearly present face and follows the recorded vest and front-only X-strap design change. The only findings are minor.",
  "findings": [
    {
      "check": "malformed",
      "severity": "minor",
      "observation": "Thin horizontal stray lines stick out of the silhouette in the wireframe: at belt height on both sides of the waist, and at knee height left of the left boot cuff. They look like degenerate sliver triangles or stray edges. They can't be seen in the shaded or clay views, and they fit the 13 non-manifold edges and 2 open boundary loops in the metrics.",
      "evidence": "assets/manifests/player/judge/mesh-1/07_wireframe_front.png; assets/manifests/player/judge/mesh-1/06_clay_front.png; metrics.mesh.non_manifold_edges=13, holes_boundary_loops=2"
    },
    {
      "check": "concept_match",
      "severity": "minor",
      "observation": "The back of the vest has an extra strap or flap over the right shoulder only, so the plain back panel is slightly lopsided. Close up only; the back still reads as the plain panel with horizontal waist straps that the design note records.",
      "evidence": "assets/manifests/player/judge/mesh-1/09_closeup_back.png; assets/manifests/player/judge/mesh-1/04_back.png"
    },
    {
      "check": "other",
      "severity": "minor",
      "observation": "The mouth is present but soft and smudged compared with the concept's cleaner mouth line, as expected from the painted overlay. It still reads.",
      "evidence": "assets/manifests/player/judge/mesh-1/08_closeup_front.png; assets/manifests/player/judge/mesh-1/01_approved_concept.png"
    }
  ],
  "questions_answered": [
    "Yes. Present: spiky dark hair; stand collar in the tunic color; leather vest with the X-straps on the front only; waist belt; knee-length tunic with a front split and a flared hem; dark trousers; iron-grey wrist bracers; tall leather boots with folded cuffs; empty hands in a T-pose. The back is a plain vest panel with two horizontal waist straps, as the design note records. Changed: only an extra right-shoulder strap on the back of the vest (minor).",
    "Nothing major. Limbs are separate and nothing is fused. Hands have visible fingers, and there are no extra props. The 4 small extra parts (roughly 1 to 4 cm) are consistent with eyes or small facial pieces and are not floating fragments. There are 2 open boundary loops (limit 10) and 13 non-manifold edges. A few sliver edges show only in the wireframe, at the waist and knee (minor).",
    "Pass: 4,893 of 5,500 triangles; one 256x256 albedo; 1.8 m tall, matching the target.",
    "All color assertions pass. The deep navy-teal tunic, the skin tone, the dark reddish-brown leather, the dark hair and the dark trousers are all kept, each within 1.3 of its concept color after correction (limit 5). No large area is in an unrequested color. The golden-yellow stitching and the patch are not there, but the brief says they get painted during the later texture pass, so that isn't a loss at this stage.",
    "The validate step reports the mesh can be mapped to the humanoid skeleton (humanoid_mappable true) with no required bones missing. Sockets are null, so they weren't checked in this packet.",
    "Eyes: clearly present. Nose: clearly present. Mouth: present, a little soft (the painted overlay) but readable (08_closeup_front.png)."
  ],
